posts.body:
Hi all,

I've just found out I'm 5 weeks pregnant which I'm so pleased about 

My contract is 14 hours per week at pay £7.20 rarely do I work just 14 hrs normally it's 19-21min and sometimes full time hours. Now looking at stationary pay it says I should earn £112 a week which with overtime I do but on my basic hours I don't. Does stationary pay work on actual payslips or on contract?

Last year there was mention about my contract changing to 28hr but for now it's in limbo due to company issues.

Hope this is the right section and any advise would be fab.

Tia

posts.body: I think they work it out on a certain number of weeks during your pregnancy and average it so if you work those hours normally you should be ok.
